title: Twelve Monkeys Harambae Iced Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Harambae Iced by Twelve Monkeys delivers a lively medley of citrus flavours, blending the tart zing of Lemon and Lime with the tangy-sweet notes of Grapefruit and Orange. A touch of Guava adds a soft tropical sweetness, while a cool menthol exhale enhances the crisp, refreshing character of this citrus-forward vape. Crafted with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Harambae Iced is ideal for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) vape devices, offering rich flavour, dense vapour production and a smooth, gentle throat hit. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength to suit their preference. If you prefer this flavour without the cooling sensation, the original un-iced version is also available right here at Vapestore. Twelve Monkeys are a legendary Canadian e-liquid brand whose fiendishly inventive approach to vape juice flavours has resulted in a reputation for delivering expertly blended e-liquids that combine bold fruit flavours with the highest-quality ingredients to create a uniquely satisfying vaping experience.
